evidence.evidence_text: This study investigates the differences between entity and relational knowledge through knowledge editing.
To further elucidate the differences between entity and relational knowledge, we employ causal analysis to investigate how relational knowledge is stored in pre-trained models.
Large language models encapsulate knowledge and have demonstrated superior performance on various natural language processing tasks.
Recent studies have localized this knowledge to specific model parameters, such as the MLP weights in intermediate layers.
